scope: The owned subset: the 25 works the locked structure places in this room, in room order.
introduction: Heads by Scrimshaw, a different artist. These twenty-five works are the earliest in the collection, most of them drawn on February 16, 2021, the rest over the following days, with a few returns as late as December 2023. They hang together because they share one way of drawing: a head built from loose, looping colored line, on a bright ground. They were on the board eight months before nnxyz's first ink, and they bare their teeth the same way.

The line is the whole method. A head is a loop, then another loop in another color, then a third, until the face is a weave of blue, red and yellow lines that never quite close. Eyes are rings. Teeth are zigzag. Hair is a crest of straight strokes. Who saw whom is not in the record, and the gallery does not guess. What the record holds is a thread: nnxyz liked three of Scrimshaw's inks on the board, and in April 2022 Scrimshaw received the sixth of the Abstract paintings as a gift. Two artists who drew a mouth the same way, and one of them said thank you in paint.

The collector is the other thread. Jamie Thingelstad bought the greeting GM in April 2022, three weeks before his first nnxyz purchase, and then, on two evenings in August 2022, bought twenty-one of these heads within ten minutes each night: the first night was the one he bought the first two nnxyz drawings, and the second was the day before he bought the Faces origin piece. He has said he sees a related visual character in Scrimshaw. The wall agrees. Watch the halos: several heads have a ring or an oval drawn above them, and it is one of the marks that sets these apart from the nnxyz masks in the other wings.

chapters.title: One Evening in February
chapters.opening: February 16, 2021, from the afternoon to midnight. Ten drawings in seven hours, from a pale face in blue line to a long-haired face in pink. The collector bought all ten on the evening of August 11, 2022, Minneapolis time, within five minutes.

works.title: Scrimshaw1
works.text: A face drawn in one blue line over a pale ground of yellow and lilac discs, with a square chin, two small eyes and a zigzag of teeth, a crest of blue strokes above. The line wanders from the brow down the nose to the jaw and back, and the pale color behind it is laid in soft overlapping shapes. It is the earliest work in the whole collection, from the afternoon of February 16, 2021, when Nifty Ink was six months old. The face is calm and the teeth are a zigzag. Before nnxyz drew a single ink, this mouth was on the board, drawn by someone else, and the collector bought it eighteen months later on the night he began buying nnxyz in earnest.
works.caption: A face drawn in one blue line over pale yellow and lilac discs, a square chin, a zigzag of teeth.
works.reading: The blue line is a single color at a single width, and it crosses itself at the eyes and the mouth. The ground behind is translucent: a pink square, yellow and lilac blobs, grey scribble. The crest above the head is a few straight blue strokes.

works.title: Scrimshaw2
works.text: A skull drawn in looping blue, white and yellow line on blue, with ringed eyes and a mouth of purple teeth, vertical strokes falling around it like hair.
works.caption: A skull in looping blue, white and yellow line on blue, ringed eyes, a mouth of purple teeth.
works.reading: The loops are thick and run around the eye sockets several times. The teeth are purple zigzag in a white mouth. The vertical strokes run from the top to the bottom edge in blue, white and green.

works.title: Scrimshaw3
works.text: Three heads outlined in thick black line on purple, side by side, their faces filled with orange, white and blue scribble, their noses and mouths drawn in a few black strokes. The black outline runs around all three without a break. It is the first drawing in the collection with more than one face, and the one where the line is heaviest. Three heads in one outline is a family or a band, and the grins are mild. Ten months later nnxyz drew a crowd of heads for the first New Nifty on the Block, in a different hand, with more teeth.
works.caption: Three heads outlined in thick black line on purple, their faces filled with orange and blue scribble.
works.reading: The heads overlap at the shoulders. Each has two eyes drawn as small loops and a mouth drawn as a short curve. White line runs over the faces in loose loops. The purple ground is brightest at the top.

works.title: Scrimshaw4
works.text: A face in dark purple line on light blue, with ringed eyes, a red mouth of teeth, and a crest of purple strokes, drawn in sixty-nine strokes.
works.caption: A face in dark purple line on light blue, ringed eyes, red teeth, a purple crest.
works.reading: The line is thin and runs in long loops. The eyes are rings with red inside. The mouth is a red zigzag. Short strokes of red, green and white stand out from the head. The ground is flat light blue.

works.title: Scrimshaw5
works.text: A skull face on yellow framed in red line, with a cross on its brow, two ringed eyes in red and blue, a mouth of white zigzag teeth, and green hair drawn in straight strokes. Blue zigzag runs across the lower half. The red frame is a box drawn around the head in a few strokes. The face is a skull, but with hair and a frame it is also a portrait. The ringed eyes, the zigzag teeth, the red frame: three of the parts nnxyz would build a year of masks from are on this one yellow square from February 2021. The gallery states the date and stops there.
works.caption: A skull face on yellow in a red frame, a cross on its brow, zigzag teeth, green hair.
works.reading: The cross is a small red mark at the top of the brow. The eyes are concentric rings in red, white and blue. The teeth are two rows of white zigzag in a red mouth. The hair is green strokes with red over it.

works.title: Trio1
works.text: Three narrow figures stand together in a field of orange, their upright bodies assembled from red, blue, white and yellow lines. Looking can alternate between three characters and one interwoven pattern. They have halos, or hats, drawn as loops above the heads, and they are the first standing figures in the collection.
works.caption: Three narrow figures stand together in a field of orange, their bodies assembled from colored lines.
works.reading: The figures have round heads with loops for faces, and halos drawn above them in yellow. Their bodies are long vertical strokes that run to the bottom edge. The figure at the right has red wings. A yellow square sits behind them.

works.title: Scrimshaw6
works.text: A painted face in brown on yellow with long hair, two blue-ringed eyes and a small mouth, blue line drawn over the paint.
works.caption: A brown painted face on yellow with long hair and blue-ringed eyes, blue line over the paint.
works.reading: The face is painted in soft brown and tan with the features drawn over it in blue and red line. The hair falls in long brown and yellow strokes. The ground is yellow with pale scribble.

works.title: Scrimshaw6
works.text: A large head nearly fills the square, assembled from thick red, black and yellow lines. Its eyes receive different frames: a purple ring on one side and orange loops on the other. Yellow and blue ovals organize the dark mouth into repeated rows. Two eyes that do not match and a mouth of ovals in rows: of all the Scrimshaw heads this is the one that most resembles the nnxyz masks, and it was drawn in February 2021. The title repeats a number, and the collection keeps both.
works.caption: A large head of thick red, black and yellow lines, a purple ring and orange loops for eyes.
works.reading: The ground is green with pale discs. The mouth is a dark mass of black strokes with yellow ovals in two rows and a blue one at the side. A yellow loop at the right is an ear. The second of two works titled Scrimshaw6, drawn half an hour after the first.

works.title: Scrimshaw7
works.text: A pale face with a spiral drawn above it, rays of red and purple fanning from the spiral, two ringed eyes and a mouth of white zigzag teeth.
works.caption: A pale face with a spiral above it, rays of red and purple fanning out, white zigzag teeth.
works.reading: The spiral at the top is purple and white. The rays are straight strokes of red, purple and black from the spiral to the edges. The face is pale green and lilac with the features in thin line.

works.title: Scrimshaw8
works.text: A face with long black hair drawn in straight strokes over pink and teal lines, on yellow, a pink halo above, the face a few black strokes.
works.caption: A face with long black hair drawn in straight strokes over pink and teal, on yellow, a pink halo above.
works.reading: The hair falls from a part at the crown in long strokes to the shoulders. The face is drawn in black line with a pink cheek and a small mouth. A red zigzag runs along the bottom. The halo is a pink oval.

chapters.title: The Next Days
chapters.opening: February 17 to 22, 2021. A faint face on orange, a haloed face on purple, a grid of sixteen faces, and three more heads.

works.title: Scrimshaw9
works.text: A faint face in white, blue and yellow line on orange, tipped to the right, with blue strokes for hair, in fifty-two strokes.
works.caption: A faint face in white, blue and yellow line on orange, tipped to the right, blue strokes for hair.
works.reading: The lines are thin and pale, so the face is found slowly. The hair is a patch of blue and purple strokes at the upper left. The mouth is a small loop at the lower center. The orange ground is flat.

works.title: Scrimshaw8
works.text: A face with long black hair drawn in straight strokes over pink and teal lines, on yellow, a pink halo above, the face a few black strokes.
works.caption: A haloed long face on purple in dense purple, red and white scribble, a gold ring above the head.
works.reading: The scribble is dense enough that the face is dark at the center. The halo is a gold oval. The eyes are two white rings. Red strokes fall at the sides like hair.

works.title: Scrimshaw12
works.text: Sixteen faces in a grid of four by four on purple, each drawn in loose black and white line with a different expression: one grins, one frowns, one has a mouth of teeth, one looks sideways. The grid lines are drawn by hand. It is the most densely drawn work in the Scrimshaw collection, and the only grid. Sixteen moods on one page, drawn in a sitting on February 18, 2021: it is the room's clearest statement that the face was the subject and the expression was the game, and the same game nnxyz would play across three hundred masks.
works.caption: Sixteen faces in a hand-drawn grid of four by four on purple, each with a different expression.
works.reading: The faces fill their cells and are drawn in the same loose line, black with white and pink over it. Some have hair, some have teeth, one at the upper right is pink. The purple ground shows between the loops.

works.title: Scrimshaw13
works.text: A face with a wide black ring above it like a hat, drawn in black, red and blue line on pale green, with a target eye and an X eye, a red mouth and a spiral at the chin, the X and the target in one face in February 2021.
works.caption: A face with a wide black ring above it like a hat, one target eye, one X eye.
works.reading: The ring is a flat black oval drawn several times. The target eye is red and white rings; the X eye is a cross in a ring. The mouth is red zigzag. The neck is a column of black strokes.

works.title: Scrimshaw14
works.text: A blue head on yellow with a crest of blue strokes, two ringed eyes, and a mouth open on black zigzag teeth, a spiral at the upper right.
works.caption: A blue head on yellow with a crest of blue strokes, ringed eyes, black zigzag teeth.
works.reading: The head is drawn in blue, white and red loops. The crest is long blue strokes leaning to the left. The mouth is a dark oval with white and black zigzag. The spiral at the upper right is blue.

works.title: Scrimshaw15
works.text: A long-haired face on blue with red and purple hair falling in long strokes, two ringed eyes with crosses, and a mouth of black zigzag teeth.
works.caption: A long-haired face on blue, red and purple hair falling in long strokes, crossed eyes, black zigzag teeth.
works.reading: The hair runs from the crown to the lower edge in straight strokes of red, purple and blue. The eyes are rings with X marks. The mouth is a dark oval with zigzag.

chapters.title: Figures and Later Heads
chapters.opening: March to August 2021. Five figures standing together, a boxed face, a spiky head, a crossed eye, and two heads on black.

works.title: Stick Together
works.text: Five upright figures stand close together, their long colored bodies filling the square. Thin lines cross between them, while differences in facial marks and color keep each figure distinct. Loops above their heads repeat the same gesture across the group. The title is an instruction, from March 2021, a year before the market fell, and it is the gentlest picture in the wing: five people in a row, each a different color, holding still together. The collector bought it on August 12, 2022, the day after nnxyz began burning the unsold inks.
works.caption: Five upright figures stand close together, their long colored bodies filling the square, loops above their heads.
works.reading: The bodies are drawn in vertical strokes of orange, tan, green and purple. The faces are dense scribble with white and red marks. The loops above are drawn in pale line like halos. The ground is pale green.

works.title: Scrimshaw 18
works.text: A boxed face on orange drawn in purple, blue and yellow line, two ringed eyes, a mouth of zigzag, and a spiral at the chin, with loops running out past the box.
works.caption: A boxed face on orange in purple and yellow line, a zigzag mouth, loops running out.
works.reading: The box is drawn in black with the face inside it. The loops of purple and yellow run out of the box to the edges. The mouth is a long zigzag in red and blue.

works.title: Scrimshaw 21
works.text: A spiky-haired head on yellow, drawn in black, red and blue line, with a ringed eye, a long nose and a mouth of white teeth, in sixty-nine strokes.
works.caption: A spiky-haired head on yellow in black, red and blue line, a ringed eye, a long nose, white teeth.
works.reading: The spikes are thick black, red and blue strokes standing up from the crown. The eye is a ring with a red center. The nose is a long curve. The teeth are white bars in a red mouth.

works.title: Scrimshaw 24
works.text: A face on purple with one eye crossed out in yellow, a ringed eye beside it, and a grin of white teeth, drawn in dense purple, red and yellow scribble with a cloud of black loops above for hair. It is the most worked drawing in the Scrimshaw collection, with 320 recorded strokes, and the crossed eye is drawn as a yellow X in a red ring. May 11, 2021: an eye cancelled with an X, a grin, and a head buried in scribble, five months before nnxyz arrived on the board. The gallery does not say nnxyz saw it. It says it was there.
works.caption: A face on purple with one eye crossed out in yellow, a ringed eye beside it, grinning.
works.reading: The scribble covers the whole face in loops of purple, red, yellow and teal. The hair is a cloud of black loops at the top. The teeth are white zigzag in a dark mouth. A yellow zigzag at the upper right is a crown.

works.title: Scrimshaw 33
works.text: Two heads on black, drawn in pink, purple and yellow line, facing each other, with a red loop between them like a handle.
works.caption: Two heads on black in pink, purple and yellow line, facing each other, a red loop between them.
works.reading: The heads are tall ovals filled with colored scribble. The left one has a purple ring for an eye; the right has a spiral. The red loop runs from one chin to the other.

chapters.title: Returns, 2023
chapters.opening: Four works from August to December 2023, two and a half years after the rest: a dark head with a red mouth, a face with a third eye, a brown face on black, and a crowned skull. The collector bought each within days of its appearing.

works.title: Scrimshaw 40
works.text: A dark head on grey with green hair, a crossed eye, a red mouth of teeth, and colored scribble inside the face, drawn in black and purple line; the collector bought it the day after it appeared, in August 2023.
works.caption: A dark head on grey with green hair, a crossed eye, a red mouth of teeth, colored scribble inside.
works.reading: The hair is green strokes standing up at the right. The crossed eye is a white X on blue. The mouth is a red oval with a row of teeth. The face is filled with green, blue and orange scribble.

works.title: Wobbler
works.text: A face on teal with one ringed eye at the left, a blue eye at the right, a third eye drawn on the forehead in a diamond, and a mouth of black bars, drawn in orange, pink and blue line over a soft ground. A black hook hangs from the left ear. The title is Wobbler, and the face leans to the left as if it might. Drawn in October 2023, when nnxyz was drawing the numbered masks a few a month and the board was quiet; the collector bought it ten days later. The third eye is new. The mouth of bars is the old one.
works.caption: A face on teal with a ringed eye, a blue eye, and a third eye in a diamond.
works.reading: The ringed eye is a black ring with a blue center. The third eye is drawn small in a diamond at the brow. The mouth is a row of black bars. The ground is teal with yellow and pink strokes.

works.title: Scrimshaw 41
works.text: A brown face on black drawn in white and black loops, two ringed eyes and a third ring above, a mouth of white zigzag teeth, in seventy-two strokes.
works.caption: A brown face on black in white and black loops, three stacked rings, white zigzag teeth.
works.reading: The face is painted in soft brown with the loops drawn over it. The three rings are stacked, two at the eyes and one at the brow. The teeth are a box of white zigzag at the bottom. Blue and pink lines run at the edges.

works.title: Scrimshaw 42
works.text: A skull in profile on black, facing left, drawn in pink, cyan, yellow and red line, with a yellow crown floating above it and a ringed eye, its teeth a row of yellow and orange bars. The line is thick and clean, every color separate. It is the last work in the Scrimshaw collection, from December 14, 2023, and where the first face was one blue line on a pale ground, this one is a dozen colors on black. A crowned skull in profile on black is also, almost exactly, the collection piece of New Nifty on the Block, drawn fourteen months earlier by the other artist. The collector bought it three days later. The gallery notes the rhyme and leaves the two artists to it.
works.caption: A skull in profile on black in pink, cyan, yellow and red line, a yellow crown floating above it.
works.reading: The crown is a yellow zigzag at the upper right, not touching the head. The eye is a ring of purple and white. The teeth are yellow and orange bars in a cyan mouth. Yellow hatching fills the top of the skull.

closing: Look again at the first face, one blue line over pale color, drawn on a February afternoon in 2021, and then at the crowned skull on black from December 2023. The line got thicker and the ground got darker. The loops stayed. The last head wears a crown, like the last nnxyz masks of 2022, and the gallery leaves it at that: two artists, one board, one mouth, and a collector who hung them in the same house.
